comparability.claim: Complete AWM-AutoRoute CoinRun v4 pilot run with held-out final evaluation; comparable to other runs with the same protocol and commit.
limitations: Training is task-aware while action selection and final inference are task-ID-free; this is not a task-agnostic training protocol.
The five archived seeds were selected after observing final scores from eight completed runs, so this subset is not an unbiased or predeclared five-seed paper cohort.
Final-minus-acquisition forgetting uses different evaluation cohorts and therefore includes sampling noise.
No external normalization anchors are applied and direct comparison to published ARROW tables is not claimed.

notes: Full external run archive is stored locally under runs/main_results/coinrun/awm_autoroute/seed2026091703/ and excluded from Git.
The full archive includes weights, boundary snapshots, replay mmap data, routing traces, TensorBoard events, logs, manifests, and evaluation outputs.
This record preserves the run as evidence without upgrading its launch-time pilot classification.

evaluation_protocol.caveat: Final-minus-acquisition estimates include evaluation-cohort sampling noise; first-pass retention uses matched validation cohorts.
